protocol: Each seed draws a private frame and a uniform hidden in-plane direction. All four arms receive the identical n independent 10%-flipped final parity labels. Candidates fit on the nested n-2048 fit stream. Select minimum mismatches on a disjoint fixed 2048 noisy-label validation block, using increasing norm then increasing angular grid as tie-break. Recompute the selected fit using all n labels. Oracle and shortened baselines also use all n. Held-out clean labels used only after selection. One test stream per seed, common across arms and positive overlaps. Primary endpoint rho=1 hard risk and hard target at n=2^21; off-grid .9 and moderate .5 explicitly retained. Six paired seed t intervals, no adjustments. Reuse existing sign-magnitude gate and recovery with no gradients.
